source.author: verg
source.text: Poenarum exhaustum satis est, via facta per hostis.
source.text_original: Poenarum exhaustum satis est, via facta per hostis.'
source.text_english: Punishment has been sufficiently exacted, the way has been made through the enemy.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: via facta per undas perque hiemes, Bellona, tibi.
reuse.text_original: via facta per undas / perque hiemes, Bellona, tibi.
reuse.text_english: a road made through the waves and through the winters, O Bellona, for you.
